Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the question’s intent. Instead of identifying the parent organization that the college is part of (e.g., Brooklyn College is part of the City University of New York), the Planner redirected the effort toward finding corporate/industry affiliations and even introduced an unfounded “Global Academic Network.” This led the process down an irrelevant path (industrial affiliate partners) and produced a final answer listing partner companies rather than the correct parent organization.
